subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A school project asked students to make a language map of their neighborhood.”?
options: Some were used for business, some for religion, and some for communities that had moved there from other places.
A student from an apartment with little kitchen space asked if solar cooking was used in real places.
His teacher moved him closer to the front until he got used to the glasses.
The science club used small thermometers to measure different places on campus.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Some were used for business, some for religion, and some for communities that had moved there from other places.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A student from an apartment with little kitchen space asked if solar cooking was used in real places.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「His teacher moved him closer to the front until he got used to the glasses.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The science club used small thermometers to measure different places on campus.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
